notes.title: 🧠 5 New Chapters + Bestiary Now Live! 🐉
notes.content:
[p][b]5 New Chapters + Bestiary Now Live!

[/b]It’s finally here! 

After 600+ hours of story writing, boss creation, level design, balancing, and beautiful new backgrounds... Chapters 31–35 are now available! 
Expect major reveals, new monsters, and fresh gameplay challenges.

Every time you defeat a monster, it gets added to your personal collection with lore and stats.

We’ve teamed up with Pyrocynical for a special limited-time collaboration across all versions of the game.

Here’s what you get:

[list]

notes.title: Lunar Explore Event – Dive Into the Rewards!
notes.content:
🌑 Explore the Moons – Earn Big Rewards!

The Lunar Fest Event is now Live in Eden Survivors! 

Play the game and complete quests to earn Sonar Tickets and uncover powerful rewards hidden in a mysterious 5x5 lunar grid.

🎯 Finish 3 lines on the board to complete it and claim major prizes.
🌟 Finish 3 lines, find 3 golden asteroids and unlock the Golden Lunar Fest, a special bonus board that doesn’t require tickets and has massive rewards
💎 Collect Lunar Crystals to spend in the event shop for exclusive loot.
📈 Track your progress through the Sonar Counter and unlock extra milestone rewards.
💰 Out of tickets? You can buy extra draws with gems anytime.

Enjoy it commander!
